cards.title: Scope
items: Parsed Python source; no LLM, target execution, or target imports.
Expressions are atomic. Loops show symbolic iteration; loop else runs on normal completion, not break. Iterator protocol internals are not expanded.
Except clauses are tested in order with symbolic type matches. May-raise edges are conservative, not proven feasible paths.

Try else runs only on normal try fallthrough. Handler/else exceptions propagate outward. Finally preserves separate pending exits; abrupt cleanup replaces the pending exit. Except* remains unsupported.
Function setup, nested bodies, callees, exception identity/chaining, exception-variable cleanup, and implicit exceptions outside modeled exception regions are not expanded.
